description: Queues, lists, removes or clears changes the owner wants made during the move: rename or drop a data type or field, add a field, drop a page, change a list of choices, or swap the email provider (all automatic), or describe anything else in plain words. Names are checked against the plan from nc_compile_plan. Nothing in the owner's app changes, nothing is charged, and the move score does not change.

params.description: For example { new_name }, { new_name, field_type (text, number, boolean, date, image, file, geographic_address) }, { add, remove } for a list of choices, { provider (brevo, sendgrid, mailgun, postmark, resend, cloudflare_email) }.

target.description: A page, data type or type.field, or a list of choices, as named in the plan.

text.description: Plain words, required when kind is other (up to 2,000 characters).

name: nc_changes
title: Queue changes for the move (free)
